column4: Evaluation anxiety is a natural response to high-stakes environments. Use the 5-4-3-2-1 sensory grounding technique: Identify 5 things you see, 4 you can touch, 3 you hear, 2 you smell, and 1 you taste to lower acute cognitive load.

Sleep architecture directly influences emotional regulation. Maintain a strict sleep-wake window, ensure your room is cool (around 18°C), and remove digital blue light exposures 40 minutes before trying to sleep.
Transitioning to university often disrupts familiar social safety nets. Try micro-engagements: study in common areas rather than private rooms, or attend a single campus club meeting this week.
